test_UntargetedPGDAttack: test the ibp.UntargetedPGDAttack class with a predictor network, linear specification, epsilon bound, and optimizer builder
test_MultiTargetedPGDAttack: test the ibp.MultiTargetedPGDAttack class with diverse epsilon values across input dimensions
test_RestartedAttack: test the ibp.RestartedAttack wrapper that wraps an attack with multiple restarts for improved robustness
test_LinearSpecification: test the ibp.LinearSpecification class used to define linear objectives for attack maximization and minimization
test_attack_optimizers: test ibp.UnrolledGradientDescent, ibp.UnrolledAdam, and ibp.UnrolledSPSAAdam optimizers with PGD attacks
